title: sgmo-20210122
主要内容: Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. announced that Sung Lee, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Principal Financial Officer, notified the company of his resignation from these positions and employment, effective February 1, 2021. On January 22, 2021, the company and Mr. Lee entered into a letter agreement, under which Mr. Lee will serve as an independent contractor from February 2 to February 26, 2021. During this period, he will no longer serve as Chief Financial Officer but will continue as Principal Financial Officer in a consulting role, assisting with financial transition activities, including the filing of the 2020 Annual Report on Form 10-K. His compensation for this role will be a lump sum payment of $215,000 on February 26, 2021, which will be considered an annual cash bonus under the Amended and Restated Incentive Compensation Plan, subject to legal conditions.
